product_overview: Al-Athar Foundation is a Laravel 12 enterprise CMS that powers a public-facing foundation website and a protected admin dashboard. It supports content management, localized pages, surveys, contact handling, and configurable homepage sections.
core_goals: Provide secure authenticated access to dashboard features with role-based authorization and email verification.
Enable administrators to manage public content such as news, programs, projects, services, team members, and governance documents.
Support a dynamic homepage and localized public site experiences in Arabic and English.
Allow public survey submissions and contact inquiries with validation and anti-spam protections.
Maintain configurable application settings and reusable media/file uploads for content management.

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Allows users to sign in, verify their email, and access protected dashboard functions based on role permissions.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with authenticated session or token -> GET /api/auth/user with auth context -> Receive 200 with user details and roles
POST /api/auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 with authentication error
POST /api/auth/email/verify with valid verification token -> Receive 200 confirming email verification -> GET protected dashboard endpoint with verified user -> Receive 200 access granted
POST /api/auth/email/verify with expired or invalid token -> Receive 422 or 400 with verification failure

features.name: News Management
features.description: Supports creating, editing, publishing, and organizing news stories with media attachments and status control.
user_flows: POST /api/news with valid article data and media -> Receive 201 with created news item -> GET /api/news/{id} -> Receive 200 with saved story and metadata
PATCH /api/news/{id}/status with admin credentials -> Receive 200 with updated publish status -> GET /api/news/{id} -> Receive 200 showing new status
POST /api/news with missing required fields -> Receive 422 validation errors
POST /api/news/{id}/media with unsupported file type -> Receive 422 or 415 media upload error

features.name: Program Management
features.description: Enables administrators to create and manage programs, including status toggling for visibility on the public site.
user_flows: POST /api/programs with valid program details -> Receive 201 with created program -> GET /api/programs/{id} -> Receive 200 with program data
PATCH /api/programs/{id}/status with admin credentials -> Receive 200 with updated status -> GET /api/programs/{id} -> Receive 200 reflecting updated visibility
POST /api/programs with invalid or incomplete payload -> Receive 422 validation errors

features.name: Project Management
features.description: Manages projects with slug generation, localized content, and linkage to programs for public presentation.
user_flows: POST /api/projects with project details linked to a program -> Receive 201 with generated slug -> GET /api/projects/{slug} -> Receive 200 with project details and associated program
PATCH /api/projects/{id} with updated title/content -> Receive 200 with updated project and regenerated or preserved slug as configured
POST /api/projects with duplicate or invalid slug-conflicting data -> Receive 422 validation error or uniqueness error
POST /api/projects with missing program relationship -> Receive 422 validation errors

features.name: Service Management
features.description: Provides CRUD operations for public services displayed on the website.
user_flows: POST /api/services with valid service data -> Receive 201 with created service -> GET /api/services/{id} -> Receive 200 with service details
PATCH /api/services/{id} with updated fields -> Receive 200 with updated service data
POST /api/services with invalid payload -> Receive 422 validation errors
DELETE /api/services/{id} without required authorization -> Receive 403 forbidden

features.name: Team Members
features.description: Allows administrators to manage board and executive team member profiles and associated photos.
user_flows: POST /api/team-members with profile data and photo upload -> Receive 201 with created team member -> GET /api/team-members/{id} -> Receive 200 with member details and media
PATCH /api/team-members/{id} with updated role/title and new photo -> Receive 200 with updated profile
POST /api/team-members with unsupported image format -> Receive 422 or 415 upload error
DELETE /api/team-members/{id} with insufficient permissions -> Receive 403 forbidden

features.name: Governance Documents
features.description: Organizes governance-related documents into categories and supports secure file uploads for public retrieval.
user_flows: POST /api/governance-documents with category and file upload -> Receive 201 with stored document -> GET /api/governance-documents/{id} -> Receive 200 with document metadata and file reference
GET /api/governance-documents?category={category} -> Receive 200 with filtered document list
POST /api/governance-documents with missing file or category -> Receive 422 validation errors
POST /api/governance-documents with disallowed file type -> Receive 422 or 415 upload error

features.name: Survey System
features.description: Lets admins create surveys and view analytics while allowing the public to submit responses with throttling protections.
user_flows: POST /api/surveys with survey configuration -> Receive 201 with created survey -> GET /api/surveys/{id} -> Receive 200 with survey definition
POST /api/surveys/{id}/responses with valid answers -> Receive 201 with submitted response -> GET /api/surveys/{id}/analytics -> Receive 200 with response statistics
POST /api/surveys/{id}/responses exceeding throttling limit -> Receive 429 too many requests
POST /api/surveys/{id}/responses with invalid answers -> Receive 422 validation errors

features.name: Contact Messages
features.description: Accepts public contact form submissions with honeypot spam protection and provides a backend inbox for administrators.
user_flows: POST /api/contact-messages with valid form fields and empty honeypot -> Receive 201 confirming message submission -> GET /api/contact-messages -> Receive 200 with inbox entries
POST /api/contact-messages with honeypot field filled -> Receive 422 spam validation failure
GET /api/contact-messages/{id} with admin credentials -> Receive 200 with message details
DELETE /api/contact-messages/{id} without authorization -> Receive 403 forbidden

features.name: HomePage Sections & Hero Slides
features.description: Manages homepage layout elements such as hero slides, counters, and content sections with reorderable positions.
user_flows: POST /api/homepage/hero-slides with image and slide content -> Receive 201 with created slide -> PATCH /api/homepage/hero-slides/reorder with new order -> Receive 200 confirming updated sequence
POST /api/homepage/sections with section data -> Receive 201 with created section -> GET /api/homepage/sections -> Receive 200 with ordered sections
PATCH /api/homepage/sections/reorder with invalid ordering payload -> Receive 422 validation error
POST /api/homepage/hero-slides with missing image asset -> Receive 422 validation error

features.name: Settings
features.description: Allows administrators to update application settings and preserve cached configuration values for stable site behavior.
user_flows: GET /api/settings with admin credentials -> Receive 200 with current settings -> PATCH /api/settings with updated values -> Receive 200 with saved settings
PATCH /api/settings with invalid configuration values -> Receive 422 validation errors
GET /api/settings without authorization -> Receive 403 forbidden
PATCH /api/settings followed by cached read endpoint -> Receive 200 with updated effective settings after cache retention refresh
